tasks.title: Guard DrawSessionResult's cardinality so an inserted or appended member cannot renumber silently (backlog.md:401)
acceptance: A1. src/DungeonMaster.Tests/AppCore/Map/DrawSessionResultZeroValueTests.cs contains a new [Fact] named DeclaresExactlyFourMembers_AndOnlyNoneCastsToZero which asserts that Enum.GetValues<DrawSessionResult>() has exactly 4 elements and that the single element casting to 0 is DrawSessionResult.None. The 4 is measured, not assumed: measurement.md section 4 counts four declared members -- None, Added, Closed, Ignored -- from src/DungeonMaster.App.Core/Map/MapDrawingSession.cs:8-29, and the grep that enumerates every DrawSessionResult reference in src/ (grep -rn "DrawSessionResult" --include=*.cs src/, with /obj/ and /bin/ filtered) shows no fifth member anywhere. The shape mirrors ExactlyOneMemberCastsToZero_AndItIsNone in src/DungeonMaster.Tests/Domain/Entities/Floor/ObjectKindGuardTests.cs, the 38-member guard 6b-viii wrote for ObjectKind. Falsifiable by: dotnet test src/DungeonMaster.Tests/DungeonMaster.Tests.csproj --filter "FullyQualifiedName~DrawSessionResultZeroValueTests.DeclaresExactlyFourMembers_AndOnlyNoneCastsToZero" -- reports Passed: 1, Failed: 0.

A2. INJECTION (cardinality, single-site). With a fifth member added to the DrawSessionResult enum in src/DungeonMaster.App.Core/Map/MapDrawingSession.cs -- APPENDED after Ignored, so that the ordinals Added=1, Closed=2, Ignored=3 are all unchanged -- the command dotnet test src/DungeonMaster.Tests/DungeonMaster.Tests.csproj --filter "FullyQualifiedName~DrawSessionResultZeroValueTests" builds with exit code 0 and reports exactly one test failed, the A1 fact, and reports the three pre-existing facts in that file -- Default_IsNone, PreExistingMembers_KeepTheirRelativeDeclarationOrder and PlaceVertex_NeverReturnsNone_OnAnyOfItsThreeOutcomes -- all passing. Those three passing under this defect is the positive control, and it is simultaneously the measurement of the gap backlog.md:401 describes: today nothing reddens on an appended member. The injection is checked against this solution's analyser traps before being specified -- appending an enum member cannot fail the build here, because grep -rn "DrawSessionResult" --include=*.cs over src/ (with /obj/ and /bin/ filtered) shows no switch statement or switch expression over this enum anywhere in the solution, so no exhaustiveness or CA1508-style diagnostic is in play. The edit is reverted afterwards (see A4). This criterion encodes the Coverage rule of disciplines/test.md: "A test is shown able to fail -- seen failing before it is made to pass, or shown to catch the defect it exists for when that defect is injected."

A3. Revert the A2 injection by re-editing the file's content back, never by restoring a copy: Copy-Item preserves LastWriteTime, MSBuild then does not rebuild, and the next run reports results from a stale DLL (backlog.md, 2026-09-17 entry on Copy-Item). PRESERVE CRITERION, satisfied at startRef by design: src/DungeonMaster.App.Core/Map/MapDrawingSession.cs is CRLF throughout with a final newline once the task is done, and src/DungeonMaster.Tests/AppCore/Map/DrawSessionResultZeroValueTests.cs is CRLF throughout with a final newline, matching .editorconfig:8-9. Falsifiable by, for each file: python -c "import sys;b=open(sys.argv[1],'rb').read();print(b.count(b'
')==b.count(b'
'), b.endswith(b'
'))" <file> -- prints True True. The Edit tool emits LF and the existing file is CRLF, so an edit can mix them. grep -c $'$', cat -A and git show <rev>:<path> > file all lie about line endings in this environment and are not acceptable substitutes.

A4. PRESERVE CRITERION, satisfied at startRef by design: src/DungeonMaster.App.Core/Map/MapDrawingSession.cs is byte-identical to its content at startRef (061b28b) once the task is done -- sha256sum src/DungeonMaster.App.Core/Map/MapDrawingSession.cs reports 1e8531b10eff9d395bc7f7fc395ca4580969d322f9a808beef7fcb9e53185fca. This file is listed in owns solely so the temporary injection in A2 is legal; no permanent change to it is in scope for this task. (The precedent is 6b-x's A14, which ended byte-identical.)

A5. PRESERVE CRITERION, satisfied at startRef by design: with MapDrawingSession.cs restored, dotnet test src/DungeonMaster.Tests/DungeonMaster.Tests.csproj reports Failed: 0 and exits 0. Directory.Build.props:5 sets TreatWarningsAsErrors=true with EnforceCodeStyleInBuild=true at :16, so any formatting or analyser slip in the edited test file fails this command rather than warning -- IDE0055 is severity = warning at .editorconfig:64 and still fails the build through that pair.

tasks.title: Reject DrawSessionResult.None at the DungeonDetailPage consumer, following MutationOutcomeExtensions.ToResult (MASTER-179)
acceptance: B1. NEW FILE src/DungeonMaster.App/Views/DungeonDetailPage/DrawSessionResultGuard.cs declares internal static class DrawSessionResultGuard in namespace DungeonMaster.App.Views.DungeonDetail (the namespace its folder-neighbour PaletteThumb.cs:6 already uses, and the namespace DungeonDetailPage.xaml.cs:13 already imports, so no using directive need be added to the page). It contains internal static DrawSessionResult EnsurePlacementOutcome(this DrawSessionResult result), implemented as a switch expression with five arms: DrawSessionResult.Added, DrawSessionResult.Closed and DrawSessionResult.Ignored each yielding result unchanged; a DEDICATED DrawSessionResult.None arm throwing new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(result), result, "No placement attempt was made."); and a SEPARATE _ catch-all arm throwing new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(result), result, "Unrecognised draw session result."). The two messages must differ, and must be exactly these two strings. This mirrors MutationOutcomeExtensions.ToResult at src/DungeonMaster.Application/Common/Handlers/MutationOutcomeExtensions.cs:62-86 -- the repository's only production site handling an enum member documented as never-occurring (measurement.md section 2.4, n = 1, recorded there as a weak convention rather than a rule). Falsifiable by B9 and B10 together with B4, B5 and B6.

B2. The EnsurePlacementOutcome declaration in that file carries an XML doc comment containing an <exception cref="ArgumentOutOfRangeException"> block that names BOTH rejected cases distinctly -- DrawSessionResult.None as a declared member that MapDrawingSession.PlaceVertex never returns, and a value outside the declared DrawSessionResult members. This encodes the third element of the shape measurement.md section 2.4 counted, the <exception> block at MutationOutcomeExtensions.cs:56-60 which names both cases distinctly; it is a mechanism criterion because the mechanism is the convention being followed. Falsifiable by: grep -n "<exception" -A 6 src/DungeonMaster.App/Views/DungeonDetailPage/DrawSessionResultGuard.cs -- the printed block mentions None and mentions values outside the declared members, as two separate statements.

B3. In src/DungeonMaster.App/Views/DungeonDetailPage/DungeonDetailPage.xaml.cs, the value produced by the single call to MapDrawingSession.PlaceVertex (at startRef, :1471) passes through EnsurePlacementOutcome() before it reaches either equality comparison, so DrawSessionResult.None can no longer be compared at the two sites MASTER-179 cites (docs/audit/00-master-index.md:367, the sites at :1473 and :1489) -- it is rejected first. Falsifiable by: grep -n "PlaceVertex\|EnsurePlacementOutcome\|DrawSessionResult\." src/DungeonMaster.App/Views/DungeonDetailPage/DungeonDetailPage.xaml.cs -- exactly one PlaceVertex call is printed, EnsurePlacementOutcome is applied to its value on that same statement, and no statement printed between it and the DrawSessionResult.Added comparison reassigns the guarded local. (grep -rn "DrawSessionResult" --include=*.cs over src/ with /obj/ and /bin/ filtered shows this file holds the only two consumer comparisons in the solution.)

B4. NEW FILE src/DungeonMaster.App.Tests/Views/DrawSessionResultGuardTests.cs declares public class DrawSessionResultGuardTests in namespace DungeonMaster.App.Tests.Views and contains a [Fact] named EnsurePlacementOutcome_WithNone_ThrowsNamingTheNoPlacementAttemptCase which calls DrawSessionResult.None.EnsurePlacementOutcome() and asserts the call throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException whose ActualValue equals DrawSessionResult.None AND whose Message contains the text "No placement attempt was made.". ParamName is deliberately NOT asserted as the control: CA2208 is an error in this solution (backlog.md:375, measured in 6b-ix), so a wrong ParamName fails the build rather than reddening a test and is not the control it appears to be. No MAUI host is required -- DrawSessionResultGuard derives from nothing and the assembly grants InternalsVisibleTo("DungeonMaster.App.Tests") at src/DungeonMaster.App/AssemblyInfo.cs:3; src/DungeonMaster.App.Tests/Converters/NotNullConverterTests.cs is the existing hostless precedent in this project. Falsifiable by: dotnet test src/DungeonMaster.App.Tests/DungeonMaster.App.Tests.csproj --filter "FullyQualifiedName~DrawSessionResultGuardTests.EnsurePlacementOutcome_WithNone_ThrowsNamingTheNoPlacementAttemptCase" -- reports Passed: 1, Failed: 0.

B5. The same file contains a [Fact] named EnsurePlacementOutcome_WithAValueOutsideTheDeclaredMembers_ThrowsNamingTheUnrecognisedCase which calls ((DrawSessionResult)999).EnsurePlacementOutcome() and asserts the call throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException whose ActualValue equals (DrawSessionResult)999 AND whose Message contains the text "Unrecognised draw session result.". Falsifiable by the same dotnet test command with --filter "FullyQualifiedName~DrawSessionResultGuardTests.EnsurePlacementOutcome_WithAValueOutsideTheDeclaredMembers_ThrowsNamingTheUnrecognisedCase" -- Passed: 1, Failed: 0.

B6. POSITIVE CONTROL. The same file contains a [Theory] named EnsurePlacementOutcome_WithAPlacementOutcome_ReturnsItUnchanged with three [InlineData] cases -- DrawSessionResult.Added, DrawSessionResult.Closed, DrawSessionResult.Ignored -- each asserting the value is returned unchanged and nothing is thrown. Falsifiable by the same dotnet test command with --filter "FullyQualifiedName~DrawSessionResultGuardTests.EnsurePlacementOutcome_WithAPlacementOutcome_ReturnsItUnchanged" -- reports Passed: 3, Failed: 0. A 2-of-3 result is legible directly in that output and is not a pass.

B7. INJECTION (separate removability of the dedicated None arm). With the DrawSessionResult.None arm DELETED outright from DrawSessionResultGuard.cs, leaving the _ catch-all to absorb that value, the command dotnet test src/DungeonMaster.App.Tests/DungeonMaster.App.Tests.csproj --filter "FullyQualifiedName~DrawSessionResultGuardTests" builds with exit code 0 and reports exactly one test failed, the B4 fact, and reports the B5 fact and all three B6 cases passing. This injection is specified because the identical defect went UNDETECTED at the sibling site: backlog.md records that 6b-ix's reviewer deleted exactly this arm from MutationOutcomeExtensions.cs:77-82 and all 11 MutationOutcome tests stayed green, ToResult_WithNone_Throws included. Asserting the distinct message in B4, rather than only the exception type and ActualValue, is what makes the arm load-bearing here rather than decorative. The edit is reverted afterwards by re-editing content, never by restoring a copy. This criterion encodes the Coverage rule of disciplines/test.md: "A test is shown able to fail ... or shown to catch the defect it exists for when that defect is injected."

B8. Both new files -- src/DungeonMaster.App/Views/DungeonDetailPage/DrawSessionResultGuard.cs and src/DungeonMaster.App.Tests/Views/DrawSessionResultGuardTests.cs -- are CRLF throughout and end with a final newline, and src/DungeonMaster.App/Views/DungeonDetailPage/DungeonDetailPage.xaml.cs is still CRLF throughout with a final newline after the edit, matching .editorconfig:8-9. Falsifiable by, for each of the three files: python -c "import sys;b=open(sys.argv[1],'rb').read();print(b.count(b'
')==b.count(b'
'), b.endswith(b'
'))" <file> -- prints True True. The Write and Edit tools emit LF; grep -c $'$', cat -A and git show <rev>:<path> > file all lie about line endings in this environment and are not acceptable substitutes.

B9. PRESERVE CRITERION, satisfied at startRef by design -- the base tree already builds clean, and this asserts the new code does not change that: dotnet build src/DungeonMaster.App/DungeonMaster.App.csproj -f net10.0-windows10.0.19041.0 -c Debug exits 0, AND its captured output's MSBuild summary reports "0 Warning(s)" and "0 Error(s)", AND grep -cE "(warning|error) [A-Z]+[0-9]+" over that captured output returns 0. NOTE ON THE COMMAND, measured by orchestrator probe at Gate 2: the plain grep -icE "warning|error" standard used elsewhere in this project is correct for dotnet test -- it returned 0 over the full 969-test baseline run -- but it is UNSATISFIABLE for dotnet build, because MSBuild always prints the literal lines "0 Warning(s)" and "0 Error(s)" even on a perfectly clean build, so that command returns 2 rather than 0. The diagnostic-code form above returns 0 on a clean build and non-zero on any real diagnostic, which is the property this criterion is for. This is not a formality: with the rejection written inline in OnMapStartInteraction instead of in its own method, nameof(result) names a LOCAL rather than a parameter of the enclosing method and CA2208 fails the build -- reproduced independently by the orchestrator under AnalysisLevel 10.0 / AnalysisMode Recommended / TreatWarningsAsErrors=true / EnforceCodeStyleInBuild=true, which emitted error CA2208; the extension-method form built clean under the same settings. Close any running DungeonMaster.App before building, or MSB3026/MSB3027.

B10. PRESERVE CRITERION, satisfied at startRef by design: dotnet test src/DungeonMaster.App.Tests/DungeonMaster.App.Tests.csproj reports Failed: 0 and exits 0 with all three new facts and the B6 theory in place and the B7 injection reverted.

B11. PRESERVE CRITERION, satisfied at startRef by design: apart from the single statement B3 changes, src/DungeonMaster.App/Views/DungeonDetailPage/DungeonDetailPage.xaml.cs is unchanged relative to startRef (061b28b) -- the if (result == DrawSessionResult.Added) block including its SetActiveTool call and its three drawable/toolbar/invalidate statements, the else if (result == DrawSessionResult.Closed) branch and its await FinishDrawing(), the enclosing try/catch and every other member of the file are byte-identical. No using directive is added, because DungeonDetailPage.xaml.cs:13 already imports DungeonMaster.App.Views.DungeonDetail. Checkable from the task diff for this file, which must show one changed statement and nothing else.
